name: Table Head
description: The column-header rowgroup — for md-table. A marker element that groups the header row(s). md-table reads it to decide which rows are header rows, and in frozen-header mode projects it into the separate header grid. It has no props and no box of its own.

notes: Dedicated native md-table family (one table model: grid tracks, column template, row groups, sticky / frozen header, pinning, selection, expansion, FLIP motion). The head row group: sticky / frozen header, header row height and colours from the table.

macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against Mac Chrome 153: 118 paint cases (geometry, colours, density, RTL, dark, forced colours, hooks), 19 interaction runs frame by frame (hover, selection, expansion, sorting with the consumer, pagination, keyboard and Tab order, frozen-body and container scrolling, loading / empty, pinning / visibility, toolbar auto-bind, reduced motion).
